grammarFocus: 第三人称单数；do / does 问答；like；can / cannot；and / but。
title: A Family Cooking Chat
instructions: 这是模拟练习，不是官方考试。先听录音（或读文字稿），再做题。所有题目只根据录音内容回答。填空题必须用英文原文中的词，且只填一个词。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Leo. Do you like salad?
Leo: No, I do not like salad. But my sister Lily likes salad. She can make salad.
Mia: Can you make salad?
Leo: No, I cannot. I only make noodles. I can make great noodles and dumplings.
Mia: Does Lily like noodles?
Leo: Yes, she does. She likes noodles and salad. But she cannot make noodles.
Mia: What about your brother Tom? Does he like carrots?
Leo: No, he does not. Tom likes apples. He can make apple juice. But he cannot make noodles.
Mia: Can Tom make dumplings?
Leo: No, he cannot. Only I can make dumplings. Lily and Tom like my dumplings.
Mia: Great! I like dumplings, too.

grammar.title: 第三人称单数；do/does 问答；like；can/cannot；and/but
grammar.explanation: 在一般现在时中，当主语是 he、she 或 it 时，动词要加 -s 或 -es，例如 likes、makes。问句用 does 开头，回答用 does 或 does not。can 表示“会、能”，cannot 表示“不会、不能”，后面直接跟动词原形。and 表示“和”，but 表示“但是”。
grammar.example: She likes noodles and salad. But she cannot make noodles.

questions.explanation: 主语 she 是第三人称单数，动词 like 要加 -s 变成 likes；apples 用复数表示一类事物。
主语 he 是第三人称单数，问句用 Does 开头，后面的动词用原形 like。
can 后面用动词原形，所以是 can make，不是 can makes 或 can making。

options: I like salad, but I cannot make salad.
I like salad, and I cannot make salad.
I like salad, but I can make salad.
answers: I like salad, but I cannot make salad.
questions.explanation: but 表示转折，前后意思相反：喜欢沙拉但不会做沙拉。and 表示并列，不表示转折。
questions.evidence: No, I do not like salad. But my sister Lily likes salad.
